rationale: No. Read in full: EO 8875 delegated priority powers to the Office of Production Management (OPM) and created the Supply Priorities and Allocations Board (SPAB). EO 9024 (1942-01-16, 7 FR 329) abolished the SPAB and gave its EO 8875 powers to the War Production Board chairman; EO 9040 (1942-01-24, 7 FR 527) abolished OPM and transferred its functions, personnel, records, property and funds to the War Production Board. Paragraphs 8, 10 and 11 are one-time self-executing acts completed on 1941-08-28. The API record (6 FR 4483) and the 1989 OFR note 'Offices abolished by EOs 9024, 9040' agree and were reviewed; EO 9024's general supersession sentence was not used as a blanket end, and functions passed to the successor board (savings).
